Web Designer, Host Europe Groupdomain search
Domain search on 123-reg: one text field that interpreted whatever the user typed and searched every ending asynchronously		Domain search was the key entry point for upselling hosting, and the UX was clunky. You typed a name, picked an ending from a dropdown and hit search, because each registry needed its own API call. One domain at a time, and users kept hitting taken names. Frustrating, poor conversion.Nobody asked for it: the shop window of the business was a poor experience and worth fixing.One text field, interpret whatever the user enters, search all endings asynchronously and show them together. First use of AJAX in the stack.New revenue up 20% overnight. The approach became the industry standard: if you search for a domain anywhere today, this is how it works.Feb 2004 - Aug 2005API, growth, conversion, funnels, domains, web hosting
